description: revise an existing authored artifact document via a full-document rewrite. Use only when a narrow state-recording process is not sufficient.
embedding_description: Revise an existing authored artifact document by replacing its current content when a full-document rewrite is required. Use artifact_type to select the storage and focus configuration, artifact_id to target the record, and content to provide the corrected document body.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Writing authored artifact content to the knowledge base. patch_authored_artifact accepts {artifact_type, artifact_id, content}.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: arguments do not conform to the schema. StorageError: knowledge base write failed. UnknownArtifactType: the artifact_type is not registered.
